question: Should the experimental `claws update` command be allowed to expose an `update_partial` recovery contract for external package and Gateway mutations before operation-identity reconciliation is implemented?
rationale: The patch intentionally fails closed at unreceipted external mutation boundaries, but deciding whether status/Doctor inspection plus a fresh plan is an acceptable operator recovery experience is a product and operational policy choice rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require live recovery proof before merge
options.body: Keep the documented fail-closed contract, but require redacted real package and Gateway failure/retry evidence that shows the resulting state and recovery instructions are operable.

options.title: Pause for richer reconciliation
options.body: Defer this mutation slice until immutable operation identity and reconciliation make external partial updates recoverable without manual state interpretation.

options.title: Accept the initial experimental contract
options.body: Merge behind the experimental gate while explicitly accepting that operators must inspect status or Doctor and generate a new plan after uncertain external mutation.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the documented fail-closed contract, but require redacted real package and Gateway failure/retry evidence that shows the resulting state and recovery instructions are operable.

likelyOwner.reason: The reviewer explicitly identified the unresolved external-recovery and operator-path acceptance question.
